scripts.build: npm run build:scripts && npm run build:panel && npm run build:pot
scripts.build:pot: mkdir -p languages && wp i18n make-pot . languages/clawpress.pot --domain=clawpress --exclude=build,node_modules,vendor,tests,ideas,docs
scripts.start: npm run start:scripts & npm run start:panel
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:php
